title: Core: Layer type transitions (normal → mask → guide)
description: Test the engine functions for changing layer types in packages/core/src/engine/layer.ts. Test: setLayerType(layer, 'mask') changes type, setLayerType to 'guide' changes type, setLayerType back to 'normal', setting type of a folder layer to 'normal'. Also test that the model correctly represents masked/guided relationships between consecutive layers.
